subject: Algorithm32 Paper J4 paired-Fibonacci incoming-quadrature count ladder
profileSelection: The frozen ladder contains 34, 38, 42, 46, and 50 directions. Every candidate uses equal weights and exact antipodal pairs generated by one source-local equal-area hemisphere Fibonacci rule. Only direction count changes. The paper physical profile, W27 outgoing domain, 48 physical altitude nodes, Jthrough4 recurrence, numerical controls, measurements, and score thresholds remain unchanged.

spectralBoundary.nativeRepresentation: 40 point-sampled spectral-radiance-density channels at the paper coordinates lambda_i = 360 + 11.75*i nanometers for i=0..39
spectralBoundary.benchmarkProjection: Identity; no spectral fit, scale, RGB conversion, or 15-to-40 projection is applied.

selectionPriority: Reject a count whose independent Flat0 N4 screen crosses the retained gross-clipping limits.
Primary comparison objective is minimum aggregate B1 directional spectral-radiance RMSE.
B2 is reported as a secondary guard and does not override a clear B1 improvement.
Prefer the smallest count within 0.1 mW m^-2 sr^-1 nm^-1 of the best aggregate B1 RMSE.
rules: Output validity requires all 17 by 81 directional spectra and derived irradiances to be finite and nonnegative.
B1 is favorable at or below the published-model medians, limited at or below the upper quartiles, and adverse otherwise.
B2 is favorable only when RMSE, absolute bias, and worst absolute residual are all at or below their medians; limited only when all are at or below their upper quartiles; and adverse otherwise.
B3 must reproduce B1 aggregate RMSE within 0.000001 mW m^-2 sr^-1 nm^-1 and retain exactly the four declared mismatch fields.
All surviving frozen counts are scored; no count is introduced after observing candidate output.
